Fixed spelling of "Village"
Fixed crash for honey mini game. The crash only occurs for PC and people on Switch will not run into this problem.

notes.title: Updated battle system, added hint system, four corners update, fixed memory leak
notes.content:
Sometimes the battle system can change from turn based to active time and can kick one out of the battle menu making it feel like a hybrid battle system. This is no longer the case. The battle system should be turn based.
Default battle animation speed is now set to 2 (fastest) on PC.
Pressing the A button when there is no dialogue window can toggle a hint on where to go.
Four corners reward has been changed from a generic equipment/item to a unique equipment/item.
Fixed a memory leak that can occur when entire party dies and reloads a saved game repeatedly and then enters a scene with a large texture or sometimes loading a save slot. This can cause random crashes on the Switch and probably for PC.
The locked door at Center Layer nighttime can now be entered.
On Switch it will display a message of correct vote and find the reward when one gets correct vote at the very end.

The patch for Switch is still being reviewed by Nintendo. All previous updates and this current update will be in the patch.
